# acecloud_floating_ip (Resource)

Manages an Ace Cloud floating IP address.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `floating_network_id` (String) UUID of the external network to allocate the floating IP from.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the floating IP. Changing this forces recreation.
- `port_id` (String) ID of the port to associate the floating IP with. Changing this forces recreation.

### Read-Only

- `floating_ip_address` (String) The allocated floating IP address.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the floating IP.
- `status` (String) Current status of the floating IP (e.g. ACTIVE, DOWN).
